title: Almost every modular orbit avoids the standard-domain boundary
statement: Let G = SL₂(ℤ) act on the upper half-plane ℍ by Möbius transformations, and let μ = dx dy/y². Put F₀ = {z ∈ ℍ : 1 ≤ |z|² and |Re z| ≤ 1/2} and F₀° = {z ∈ ℍ : 1 < |z|² and |Re z| < 1/2}. For μ-almost every z ∈ ℍ, every a ∈ G satisfies: if az ∈ F₀, then az ∈ F₀°.
lean_statement: ∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), ∀ a : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, a • z ∈ ModularGroup.fd → a • z ∈ ModularGroup.fdo
